div.p: Clockwork No. 1 · Brass, steel & ivory · 驱动力 shown in plane

svg.aria-label: An animated brass clockwork orrery with eight toothed orbit wheels, meshing pinions, and planets carrying day and night terminators.

g.text: HOROLOGICAL SOLAR SYSTEM · EIGHT WHEELS · ONE ESCAPEMENT
RATE 1.00 SEC = 36.525 DAYS · ONE YEAR = 10 SEC
EPOCH J2000.0 · LONGITUDES TO SCALE, GLOVES NOT
THE MOON IS GEARED TO 27.32 d · THE SUN TURNS ON
ITS OWN AXIS IN 25.39 d · JUPITER CARRIES FOUR
OF ITS MOONS AT THEIR TRUE PERIODS.
HOVER a wheel, an arm or a globe to light its train.
FAST-FORWARD to see the outer wheels obey their true ratios.
drawn in vector · 1280 × 860 · brass, gunmetal & light
